g.text: Arthur, can we talk? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]
No, not really. I just wanted to talk to you about something that I hope isn't an uncomfortable situation for you.
I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.
What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.
Ah. I can see where this is going. You have feelings for someone else as well?
I do. And I know it might be hard to understand, but it doesn't mean I feel any less for you.
I do. But now that I think about it, I think we should probably end things here. [Break up.]
Darling, do you honestly think I spent so many years in the military and haven't seen just about every kind of relationship there is?
If that's what you really want, then...
When you spend so much of your life nearly dying, you learn to appreciate what matters in life and what doesn't.
You stop questioning lines in the sand. I completely understand.
Fact of the matter is? You matter to me. And if they matter to you, then they matter to me.
Just. Not. Not the Hex. All right? I don't think I could handle it if it were in "the family," so to speak.
Thought of it's going to give me nightmares.
For what it's worth, I really think you would like them.
Thanks. And I hope I get to meet them someday. For... personal reasons, of course.
And I hope I get to meet them someday. For... personal reasons, of course.
Just take care of yourself out there, love.
